regime: Trend-Up, Broad Risk-On (NQ Faded Off the High)
summary: Risk-on held, but the leaders split from the chasers. NQ ran to a fresh 31,616 high then faded back into its opening range to close 31,501, up 0.52 percent, so the breakout failed even though the number stayed green. ES held firmer, closed 7,880 up 0.64 percent near its 7,897 high, and the S&P cash index pushed to a new high near 7,845. The real story was gold and crude flipping back to the long side: gold reclaimed its ATR stop and closed 4,192.7 up 0.60 percent, and crude reversed an early dip to 87.64 to close 89.90 up 0.72 percent, both back above rising stops. VIX fell to 15.01, so the tape stayed calm with the federal data blackout still in force.

risk.note: Throttle stays NORMAL and sizing Standard. All four instruments closed above rising stops, with gold and crude flipping back long, so the tape is broadly up. The caution is that the indices are extended into fresh highs and NQ already faded off its high, so respect a pullback to the rising stops rather than chasing the breakout bar. Gold trades the December contract (MGC2!) after the roll, size it off that basis. The shutdown keeps federal data on hold, so keep an eye on the calendar in case delayed data lands without warning, and most prop firms restrict trading around releases.

psychology: Today was a lesson in where you enter. NQ printed a fresh high at 31,616 and then sold straight back into its opening range, so anyone who bought the breakout bar at the high spent the afternoon giving it back. The close was still green, which is the trap: a positive number can hide a session that faded from the first push. Let price come to you. A pullback to the rising stop or a hold of AVWAP is the entry, not the extension bar at a new high. Keep size standard and let the setup find you.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html: Opening range high 31,567.25, low 31,457.50, width 109.75 points. Break UP at 14:05 UTC, first 5-minute close above the range at 31,577.75, then price closed 31,480.50 back inside the range and below NYVWAP 31,537.60. HOF VWAP 31,539.58. This was a Back Into Range structure: an up-break that then closes back inside the range, which favors a fade rather than a chase. Filter state (Tuesday): no CPI, no FOMC, not Monday, so all four plays are eligible, with the HOF dead zone 12:00 to 14:00 ET and MID 9:30 to 10:30 ET only. Lesson: a break that closes back inside the range is a fade, so wait for acceptance outside the range before trusting it.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html: No signal fired. The up-break failed back into range rather than firing a fresh breakout trigger. ROC(12) is mildly positive at 0.35 percent, and price closed 31,501.50, above the 50-EMA near 31,299.90, so the regime filter is not blocking and E3v2 stays borderline. Relative volume is disclaimed on a continuous contract. The breakout long stays parked until a real volume and momentum thrust clears the high.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal (MNQ)
fullReport.html: AVWAP center 31,530.42 (1 sigma about 33 points). Bands: plus 2 sigma 31,596.63, plus 3 sigma 31,629.73; minus 2 sigma 31,464.21, minus 3 sigma 31,431.10. Price tagged plus 2 sigma at the 31,616 RTH high, then reverted all the way back below AVWAP to close 31,501.50 between AVWAP and minus 1 sigma. The plus 2 sigma tag and fade back to the center was a working upper-band rejection on a day that could not extend.
